articles.summary: BBVA Chair Carlos Torres Vila analyzed the main global economic challenges and Europe’s role in a context marked by geopolitical uncertainty this Monday at the ‘Wake Up, Spain!’ event, organized by ‘El Español’.
articles.title: Carlos Torres Vila (BBVA): “Europe needs greater unity and stronger investment ambition to enhance competitiveness and autonomy”

articles.summary: BBVA will be required to maintain a buffer of 23.94 percent of the total risk-weighted assets (RWAs) for its European resolution group. With an MREL ratio of 28.89 percent at the end of December 2025, the bank is already well above this threshold.
articles.title: BBVA Significantly Exceeds Its New MREL Requirement

articles.summary: BBVA has completed the second tranche of the €3.96 billion framework program announced in December 2025 – the largest in its history – after reaching the maximum planned amount of €1.0 billion.
articles.title: BBVA Completes Another €1.0 Billion of Its Extraordinary Share Buyback Program

articles.summary: Promoting a value and capital creation mindset is one of BBVA’s six new priorities under its 2025–2029 Strategic Plan.
articles.title: Value Creation and Capital Efficiency: Key Pillars of BBVA’s New Growth Model

articles.summary: Taking both payments into account, 2025 total dividend amounts to €0.92 per share, 31 percent higher than 2024 cash dividend and the highest paid by BBVA to date. In fact, the cash dividend per share has increased year after year since 2021, tripling the figures recorded at that time.
articles.title: BBVA to pay €0.60 per share in cash this Friday, the second payment of a record 2025 dividend

articles.summary: BBVA reported a profit of €2.99 billion in the first quarter of 2026, a 10.8% increase yoy (up 14.1% at constant exchange rates), supported by momentum in the banking business: customer loans grew 17% (at constant exchange rates), boosting net interest income by more than 20% yoy.
articles.title: Earnings: BBVA Posts Nearly €3 Billion Profit in the First Quarter (up 11%) and Announces a New Tranche of Share Buybacks
